entities.summary: The Antonivka Road Bridge, also referred to as the Antonivskyi Bridge, is a ruined box girder bridge on the Dnieper river in Kherson, Kherson Oblast, southern Ukraine. It became a flashpoint during the Russian invasion of Ukraine, and was largely destroyed in November 2022.
